sparse.selection: silver-Kazakh dev macro-F1, pooled dev tie-break; gold excluded from search

dense: One fixed feature ablation: word-only 128D -> word+character 512D. Same 30 epochs, seed, split, hidden width, diffusion steps and development checkpoint rule.

caveat: Historical gold scores were inspected before planning these experiments. Hyperparameters and checkpoints use development data, but confirmatory claims need a fresh test set. All tested changes are reported.
